about_the_game:
In this action adventure game (written by S.D. Smith), you play as the young rabbit, Helmer. Determined to reclaim his family farm, Helmer must fight his way out of the Dragon Tomb. 

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • Stealth and Combat
    Stay out of sight of patrolling guards or face them head-on. Use your fists to pummel, your sword to slash, or the environment to bonk enemies over the noggin'.

  • Challenging Enemies
    Battle swarms of bats, fearsome Nightwalkers, powerful bosses, and uncover a mysterious force pulling strings behind the scenes.

  • Puzzles and Exploration
    Navigate a dangerous underground dungeon full of brain-teasing challenges. Move boxes, pull levers, leap across collapsing platforms, and ride ore buckets through an ancient pulley system.

  • Loot and Secrets
    Crack open treasure chests hidden deep in the dungeon to find valuable loot.

  • Rescue and Progression
    Save prisoners, evade or defeat enemies, and respawn at save points when you're overwhelmed. Every scar moves you nearer to legendary status and every step brings you closer to the farm you love.

Level up your skills!

Solve puzzles!

Battle bosses!


No ads, chats, or casino tactics, just a fun, downloadable game with a beginning, middle, and end.

Wishlist this thrilling adventure set deep in the world of the best-selling Green Ember series!

Coming this Fall!
